sn52.1:1.1: sutaṁ → in B1 only; the beginning of this saṁyutta is not to be found in B2 on account of the loss of the sheet thi. (pts note)
sn52.1:2.1: sammukhe → pamukhe (bj) | balavā → S1-3 add pi. (pts note) | sammiñjeyya → B1-2 samañchitaṁ -cheyya (pts note) | eva → S1-3 evaṁ. (pts note) | sammukhe → S1-3 pamukhe. (pts note)
sn52.1:4.1: paṭikkūlasaññī → appaṭikūle paṭikūla (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | Appatikkūle → S1-3 paṭikkū- B1 patiku- both always. (pts note) | tattha → S1-3 tathā always. (pts note)
sn52.1:4.3: tattha → tatatha (sya-all) | appaṭikūle → appaṭikkule (pts) | paṭikūle → paṭikkule (pts) | paṭikūlasaññī → patikkūlasaññī (pts)
sn52.1:4.4: paṭikūle → patikkūpe (pts) | appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti appaṭikūlasaññī → appatikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti appatikkūlasaññī (pts)
sn52.1:4.5: vihareyyaṁ → S1 vihareyya S3 vihareyyanti. (pts note) | tattha → missing in S1-3. (pts note) | sampajāno → S1-3 add ti. (pts note)
sn52.1:5.1: samudayadhammānupassī → samudayadhammanupassī (pts) | viharati → S1-3 add -pe- (pts note) | ajjhattaṁ → S1-3 ajjhatta. (pts note) | samudayavayadhammānupassī → S1 B1 omit -vaya- (pts note)
sn52.1:5.2: samudayadhammānupassī → samudayadhadhammānupassī (pts) | abhijjhādomanassaṁ → S1-3 omit ātāpī etc. (pts note)
sn52.1:7.3: vayadhammānupassī viharati → vaya (pts) | abhijjhādomanassaṁ → B1 -domanassa. (pts note)
sn52.1:8.1: sa → S1-3 omit la- S1 omits se S3 sa. (pts note)
sn52.1:10.1: So → missing in S1-3 (pts note) | tattha → S1-3 tathā. (pts note)
sn52.1:10.3: hontīti paṭhamaṁ → hontī ti sāvatthi nidānaṁ (pts)
sn52.1:10.4: nidānaṁ → S1-3 Ekam samayam āy- Anu- Sāvatthiyaṁ vi- Je- Anātha- ārame. (pts note)
